data.gender_notes: Kalavati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kalavati is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Kalavati means 'Goddess of the universe'. She is often depicted as sitting on a lotus flower and holding a lotus in each of her four hands, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity she brings to the world. The name Kalavati carries the meaning “Goddess of abundance and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Kalavati usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of abundance and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kalavati represents the divine feminine energy and the abundance and prosperity that comes from tapping into that energy. She is a symbol of the nurturing and creative aspects of the divine, and is often invoked for blessings of wealth, prosperity, and fertility.
data.etymology: Kalavati belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of abundance and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalavati total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
